title: Exploring Ideas, Expressing Myself
sub: Buku pendamping Bahasa Inggris Kelas 10 SMA/MA
intro:
📌 Capaian Pembelajaran Fase E (ringkas)
  • Berkomunikasi lisan dan tulis dengan lebih lancar dalam situasi formal dan informal.
  • Memahami dan menghasilkan teks descriptive, recount (biografi), narrative, email formal, dan teks opini.
  • Menganalisis struktur teks, unsur kebahasaan, dan nilai yang terkandung di dalamnya.
cando: Menulis profil diri dengan tenses, gerund, dan to-infinitive yang tepat.
Menulis descriptive text tempat wisata dengan relative clauses.
Memahami dan menulis biografi dengan past perfect.
Menganalisis narrative text dan memakai direct speech.
Menyampaikan pendapat dengan argumen dan kata penghubung yang runtut.

sections.title: Personal profile
paras:
Nadia Ayu Lestari — Student Profile
Nadia Ayu Lestari is a tenth-grade student at SMA Negeri 2 Pontianak. She was born in Singkawang in 2010 and lives with her parents and two younger brothers.

Nadia is passionate about science and the environment. She enjoys doing experiments and writing articles for her school's online magazine. This semester, she is leading a small team that is researching ways to turn peat-land plants into eco-friendly packaging.
Her friends describe her as curious, organised, and patient. Public speaking used to be her weakness, so she joined the debate club to practise speaking in front of others.
Nadia hopes to study environmental engineering at university and to help protect Kalimantan's forests.

sections.title: Descriptive text
paras:
Raja Ampat: The Last Paradise on Earth
Raja Ampat is an archipelago which is located in Southwest Papua province. Its name, meaning “Four Kings”, comes from a local legend about four main islands: Waigeo, Batanta, Salawati, and Misool. The area consists of more than 1,500 small islands, cays, and shoals.

Raja Ampat is famous for its marine life. Scientists say that it has one of the highest levels of marine biodiversity on the planet, with hundreds of species of hard coral and well over a thousand species of reef fish. Divers who visit it can swim with manta rays, turtles, and colourful schools of fish.
Above the water, the scenery is just as breathtaking. Green karst islands rise from the turquoise sea. From the top of Piaynemo, visitors can see dozens of tiny islands spread like jewels.
The local community plays an important role in protecting the area. Visitors must pay a conservation fee, which is used to support marine protection and local people.

sections.html:
Identification
Memperkenalkan tempat: letak dan asal nama Raja Ampat.
Description
Rincian ciri: kehidupan laut, pemandangan, peran masyarakat. Bahasa: simple present, kata sifat, relative clauses.

sections.title: Biographical recount
paras:
B.J. Habibie: The Father of Indonesian Technology
Bacharuddin Jusuf Habibie was born in Parepare, South Sulawesi, on 25 June 1936. As a child, he loved reading and was fascinated by aeroplanes.

After he had finished high school, he studied at the Bandung Institute of Technology. In 1955 he continued his studies in aeronautical engineering in Aachen, Germany, and later earned a doctorate. He then worked for the German aircraft company Messerschmitt-Bölkow-Blohm, where he developed ideas that helped make aircraft safer and lighter.

In 1974, President Soeharto asked him to return home. By that time, Habibie had become a respected engineer in Europe. In Indonesia, he led the development of the aircraft industry, and in 1995 the N-250 Gatotkaca, an aircraft designed in Indonesia, made its first flight.

Habibie served as Minister of Research and Technology for twenty years, then as Vice President, and became the third President of Indonesia in 1998. He passed away on 11 September 2019. Today, his dedication to science still inspires young Indonesians.

sections.title: Narrative text
paras:
The Legend of Lake Toba
Long ago, in North Sumatra, there lived a young farmer named Toba. One day, he caught a beautiful golden fish. When he got home, the fish turned into a lovely woman. She agreed to marry him on one condition: “You must never tell anyone that I was a fish.” Toba promised.

Years later, they had a son named Samosir. Samosir was a cheerful boy, but he was always hungry. One afternoon, his mother asked him to bring lunch to his father in the rice field. On the way, Samosir felt so hungry that he ate almost all the food.
When Toba saw the nearly empty basket, he became furious. “You greedy boy! You are truly the son of a fish!” he shouted. Samosir ran home crying and told his mother.

His mother was heartbroken because Toba had broken his promise. She told Samosir to climb the highest hill. Then the sky turned dark, heavy rain fell, and water burst from the ground. The valley flooded and became a huge lake, which people call Lake Toba. The hill where Samosir stood became Samosir Island.

sections.title: A class discussion
lines: Should students be allowed to use phones at school? What do you think, Arga?
Apakah siswa boleh memakai ponsel di sekolah? Bagaimana menurutmu, Arga?
In my opinion, they should. Phones help us find information quickly and use learning apps.
Menurut saya boleh. Ponsel membantu mencari informasi dengan cepat dan memakai aplikasi belajar.
That's a good point, but many students use them for games and social media during lessons.

sections.title: Opinion text
paras:
Should Students Do Community Service?
I strongly believe that community service should be part of the senior high school curriculum.

Firstly, community service teaches students empathy. When they help at an orphanage or clean a beach, they understand the problems in their society. Moreover, it develops real-life skills such as teamwork, communication, and leadership, which are not always learned in the classroom.
Some people argue that students are already busy with lessons. However, a few hours a month is enough to make a difference, and schools can arrange it during weekends.
Therefore, community service is worth the time. It helps students grow into caring and responsible citizens.

items: What is the writer's opinion?|Community service wastes time.|Community service should be part of the curriculum.|Students should only study.
Which argument does the writer use?|It teaches empathy.|It is easy.|It is expensive.
Which word shows a contrasting idea?|Moreover|However|Therefore
